preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array a is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(d_i, int) for d_i in d)
postconditions.description: Each element d_i in the output list d is an integer.
Each element d_i in the output list d is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(d_i == -1 or d_i >= 1 for d_i in d)
postconditions.description: Each element d_i in the output list d is either -1 or a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(d_i == -1 or (a[i-1] % 2 != a[j-1] % 2 for j in range(1, n+1) if d[i-1] == bfs(i, j, a)), for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: Each element d_i in the output list d represents the minimum number of moves required to reach a position j with opposite parity from position i, or -1 if no such position exists.
